packageRules.description: Keep the version ranges in pyproject.toml; bump uv.lock within them.
Move the Python version in the Dockerfile and .python-version together.
A new Python minor (e.g. 3.15) also needs requires-python changed by hand, so wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead of opening a PR straight away.
Keep the uv used in CI and in the Docker build on the same version.
